title: Checkout latency spike and partial outage
summary: A latency regression in the checkout API caused elevated timeouts for a subset of requests. The incident was mitigated by rolling back the deployment and increasing connection pool limits.

impact.customer: ~12% of checkout attempts experienced timeouts; some customers retried successfully.
impact.internal: On-call engaged; customer support saw increased ticket volume.

timeline.event: On-call acknowledged page and began triage
Mitigated by rolling back checkout deployment
Connection pool limits increased to reduce contention

contributing_factors: Connection pool configuration was close to saturation under peak load.
Load test coverage did not include the affected traffic mix.
went_well: Alerts triggered quickly and on-call response was prompt.
Rollback procedure was well-practiced and executed without errors.
went_poorly: Customer status page update lagged initial detection.
Runbook lacked a clear checklist for connection pool tuning.

action_items.action: Add load test scenario for mixed cart sizes
Update runbook with pool tuning checklist
